--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,52 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
+                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
+                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be nonpositive log probabilities)")
+
+    shape = logp_with_result.shape
+    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+
+    n_candidates, horizon = shape
+
+    # Normalize weights
+    t = np.arange(horizon)
+    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
+    sum_weights = raw_weights.sum()
+    if sum_weights == 0:
+        normalized_weights = np.ones(horizon) / horizon
+    else:
+        normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights
+
+    # Weighted future-token losses
+    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
+
+    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
+    margins = L_minus - L_plus
+    keep = margins >= tau_filter
+
+    return keep, margins
